sources.method: Entry-level search locator used for orientation only; specific statements are checked against the higher-tier reference and official records where available.

statement.zh: **标准**：存储净化（Storage Sanitization）。IEEE 2883-2022 把存储净化分成三种方法：Clear 用接口可用的逻辑覆写/块擦除，防简单非侵入恢复；Purge 用覆写、块擦除或密码擦除，防实验室级恢复；Destruct 用粉碎、焚烧、熔化等让介质不可再用。标准同时覆盖逻辑存储与物理存储，并按 HDD、SSD、光介质、可移动介质以及 SATA/SAS/NVMe 接口给出具体要求。
statement.en: **Standard**: Storage Sanitization (存储净化).IEEE 2883-2022 divides storage sanitization into three methods: Clear uses logical overwrite/block erase through the interface against simple non-invasive recovery; Purge uses overwrite, block erase or cryptographic erase against laboratory recovery; Destruct shreds, incinerates or melts media so it cannot be reused.

statement.zh: 三种方法对应不同威胁模型与验证强度。Clear 只需代表抽样；Purge 要全量读取；Destruct 只能物理检查。把验证强度和方法混在一起，会出现“做了 Clear 却按 Purge 宣称”的过度承诺。密码擦除（CE）走另一条路径：数据仍以密文留在介质上，但媒体加密密钥被销毁；没有密钥，残留密文不可解。
statement.en: The three methods map to different threat models and verification strengths.Clear needs representative sampling; Purge needs a full read; Destruct needs physical inspection.

statement.zh: 数据生命周期先选方法：复用/转售可选 Purge 以保留介质价值；报废可选 Destruct；低敏临时清理可选 Clear，但要接受抽样验证的检测概率。Clear 抽样至少覆盖 5% 可寻址空间，或每 10,000 等分子区取 2 点并加首尾；Purge 读全可寻址空间；CE 要保留密钥销毁、密钥层级与访问控制证据；Destruct 保留物理检查记录。
statement.en: The data lifecycle first chooses a method: reuse/resale may use Purge to retain media value; disposal may use Destruct; low-sensitivity temporary cleanup may use Clear but accepts the detection probability of sampling.Clear samples at least 5% of addressable space, or two points per 10,000 equal subsections plus first/last; Purge reads the whole addressable space; CE keeps key-destruction, key-hierarchy and access-control evidence; Destruct keeps physical-inspection records.

statement.zh: 常见错误包括：把 Clear 当 Purge；把一次覆写当对所有介质都有效；忽略 SSD 磨损均衡、预留区和坏块导致的可寻址范围之外残留；把 5% 抽样通过当成“数据必然不可恢复”。CE 也不自动安全：密钥是否真销毁、是否有备份密钥、密钥管理是否可审计，决定 CE 是否成立。标准给方法与验证，不给具体产品的合规证书。### 形式模型。
statement.en: Common errors include: treating Clear as Purge; treating one overwrite as effective on all media; ignoring SSD wear levelling, over-provisioning and bad blocks outside the addressable range; treating a 5% sample pass as proof of unrecoverability.CE is not automatically safe: whether the key is truly destroyed, whether backup keys exist and whether key management is auditable decide whether CE holds.

statement.zh:
IEEE 2883-2022 于 2022-06-16 董事会批准、2022-08-17 发布，是存储净化从零散覆写指南走向方法/介质/接口分层标准的节点。IEEE 2883.1-2025 于 2025-02-12 批准、2025-06-19 发布，补充 Clear/Purge/Destruct 在复用、转售、报废和循环经济中的选择与证据要求。**技术参数与复算边界**

本条的形式模型是 \(S=\min_i S_i,\quad S_i\in\{\text{密钥强度},\text{分组安全},\text{实现安全}\}\)。输入：输入：存储净化的公开参数、密钥/随机数与消息；变量说明：S 为综合安全强度；各分量取最小值，不能只看密钥位数。
statement.en: IEEE 2883-2022 was approved by the IEEE SA Board on 2022-06-16 and published on 2022-08-17, marking the shift from scattered overwrite guides to a method/media/interface standard.IEEE 2883.1-2025 was approved on 2025-02-12 and published on 2025-06-19, adding method selection and evidence for reuse, resale, disposal and the circular economy.
